mapper.select: SELECT id, device_name, iot_id, note_name, product_id, product_name, function_name, access_location, data_value, alarm_time, processing_result, processor, processing_time, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM device_data WHERE iot_id = #{iotId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, device_name, iot_id, note_name, product_id, product_name, function_name, access_location, data_value, alarm_time, processing_result, processor, processing_time, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, remark FROM device_data
status != '0'
AND iot_id = #{iotId}

AND create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime} / 1000)
